_comment: Pinned upstream sources for tests/corpus. Regenerate trees with tests/corpus/fetch.sh. 'paths' are sparse-checkout paths inside the repo; 'root' is the path that becomes tests/corpus/<rice>/ (~/.config/hypr equivalent); 'extra' maps other repo paths to <rice>/_home/<home-relative> so absolute source= lines can be resolved. 'exclude' lists extra rsync exclude patterns.

end-4.note: Last commit before 010f070eef (2026-05-11) removed hyprland.conf and finished the hyprland.lua migration. Tree contains both .conf and the parallel .lua port.
